lightsNote: 11 of 20 real Spot lights are used (see LIGHTS_INCLUDED in convert-scene.py). The original's baked lightmaps/probes are absent from the bundle; the renderer adds a small ambient fill (documented in scene3d.js). No shadows (perf, HD 4400 target). The 3 zero-intensity event lights (Eye/Breath/Quota glint) are included and driven by game events.

floor.note: 8x8 flagstones at exact layout.json positions; mesh is the real Shell_FlagA (61 verts). Materials per stone from its GO (Room_FloorSlate pid 179 / Room_FloorStone pid 181).

sword.note: Assembly reproduced exactly from dump2 sharedassets0 TR 469 children (pos/quat/scale per part). Grade->form mapping is TODO-RE (SwordV2Catalog asset absent); the base form is used for all grades.

spawn.name: Physical sword / anvil placement
spawn.note: no baked mesh/materials - sword spawns here at runtime

hammer.note: Working hammer / animated pivot (GO 2843). Parts are placed with their WORLD transforms inside a group at the pivot origin [-1.613, 1.193, 2.031]; the swing rotates the group about its local Z axis. Exact swing kinematics are TODO-RE (animation code, not scene data).

Enhancement instrument.what: Outcome probabilities (BREAK / damage / Hold / Success / Great) + grade + value + tribute value + sword identity + latest strike + consecutive result
Enhancement instrument.channels: 5 outcome channels, each: Inset tile 0.24x0.157x0.003 m, Outcome light 0.224x0.006x0.002 m, Outcome label, Final probability, Probability bar (world scale x starts 0.0 - bars grow with probability)
Enhancement instrument.surface: Instrument_Board front face, ~1.49 x 0.71 m; text is 3D TextMesh (ForgeTax/World Text, Font Material pid 10100)

Tribute counter / iron value meter.what: Tribute quota - required value (day-1 quota 1,800) + placed value (0)

Round calendar.surface: Calendar paper and ink, pinned with 2 Old nails

Relic slots (8x Permanent item slot).texts: Engraved slot number + Relic family per slot; Relic title at [-2.65, 2.64, -0.734] + Relic subheading above

Relic vending / salvaged iron retrofit.cells: Shop cell 1/2/3 at x -0.788/-1.39/-1.992, y 1.74, z -2.39, each with Relic family + Price and stock texts
Relic vending / salvaged iron retrofit.reroll: Reroll crank at [-2.35, 1.54, -2.33], Reroll / red physical button at [-2.0, 1.17, -1.89], Gold reroll price + Sword balance texts, One sword only at [-0.933, 0.98, -1.923]

Dragon warning / crayon wall marks.note: plus the tunnel eye/face (Dragon_Face mesh at Z ~-3.5..-3.8) and the Eye light / Breath light (intensity 0.0 by default, turned on by events). Exact mapping of anger value -> wall marks is TODO-RE.
